swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs BOOT), Pin 2 (VIN vs NC), Pin 3 (EN vs NC), Pin 4 (PG vs FB), Pin 5 (FB vs EN), Pin 6 (BYPASS vs GND), Pin 7 (BOOT vs VIN). Soldering TPS5430DDAR onto a LMR33630ADDAR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

CRITICAL RECTIFICATION LAYOUT DIFFERENCE: TPS5430DDAR is non-synchronous and requires an external Schottky catch/freewheeling diode footprint near SW, whereas the counterpart integrates a synchronous low-side MOSFET.
CRITICAL SWITCH-VOLTAGE OVERSTRESS RISK: LMR33630ADDAR is rated up to only 24 V output (p.6) vs TPS5430DDAR up to 31.3 V (p.5); exceeding the internal switch BVdss ceiling destroys the SW MOSFET.
HIGH MINIMUM OUTPUT VOLTAGE FLOOR: TPS5430DDAR cannot regulate below 1.221 V (p.5) vs LMR33630ADDAR down to 1 V (p.6); verify your target rail sits above the higher Vout,min floor.
HIGH VREF MISMATCH: Feedback reference differs (LMR33630ADDAR: 1 V p.7 vs TPS5430DDAR: 1.221 V p.5); dropping in without recalculating R1/R2 will output the wrong voltage rail.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (LMR33630ADDAR: 8 µH p.20 vs TPS5430DDAR: 15 µH p.14); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: TPS5430DDAR requires Vin,min >= 5.5 V (p.4) vs 3.8 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.
CRITICAL EN FLOATING BEHAVIOR: An unconnected EN pin defaults to 'forbidden' on LMR33630ADDAR but 'enable' on TPS5430DDAR; boards relying on internal EN pull resistors will change power-up state.
CAUTION EN ABS MAX: EN pin absolute maximum differs (LMR33630ADDAR: 38 V vs TPS5430DDAR: 7 V); tying EN directly to VIN may exceed the lower rating.
engineering_verdict: LMR33630ADDAR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8E) and TPS5430DDAR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8E) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs BOOT), Pin 2 (VIN vs NC), Pin 3 (EN vs NC), Pin 4 (PG vs FB), Pin 5 (FB vs EN), Pin 6 (BYPASS vs GND), Pin 7 (BOOT vs VIN); synchronous vs non-synchronous rectification mismatch (external Schottky footprint). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (GND vs BOOT), Pin 2 (VIN vs NC), Pin 3 (EN vs NC), Pin 4 (PG vs FB). Power-stage deltas: buck (sync) vs buck (non-sync), switching frequency 400 kHz (p.8) vs 500 kHz (p.5) (1.3x ratio), typical inductor 8 µH (p.20) vs 15 µH (p.14), feedback Vref 1 V (p.7) vs 1.221 V (p.5), and package θJA 42.9 vs 42.3 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: LMR33630ADDAR "Exposed PowerPAD IS the ONLY AGND Pin on 8-Pin DDA Package (Not Optional Heat Sink!)" (p.5) and TPS5430DDAR "7 V Abs Max ENA Pin Trap & Float-to-Enable — Tying ENA to 12 V/24 V VIN Destroys TPS5430DDAR" (p.4). BOM decision: Choose LMR33630ADDAR when you want synchronous rectification without an external Schottky diode or light-load battery standby needs 24 µA Iq; choose TPS5430DDAR when programmed output rails exceed 24 V (up to 31.3 V). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.5 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
